channel.title: Busy: what's new
channel.description: Every release of Busy, free, private tools for work and life.

item.title: Busy Kitchen 1.0: Bring the world to your table.
item.description: 1,886 dishes from six kitchens, matched to what's in your fridge. The home cooking of Busy's six languages, with each kitchen's story, regions and feast days, and a recipe for every dish. Tonight: Type what is in your fridge, in any of the six languages, and see what you can cook now, and what needs one thing more. Or travel tonight to one kitchen. The six kitchens: Each kitchen's story, how to say its dishes, its regions, its pantry, how people eat, its calendar and its dishes, with pictures. Food calendar: What the six kitchens cook through the year: Sinterklaas, Advent, Semana Santa, Natale, Festa Junina, Thanksgiving and every season. Recipe Box: Your own recipes and the family's, with a photo of the handwritten card, the story behind it, and a family cookbook to print. Week Plan & Shopping: The next two weeks' dinners and the leftovers, and the shopping list that follows, on your phone through your synced folder or printed. Pantry: What is in the fridge, the freezer and the cupboard, with use-by dates. What goes off first comes first. Busy wrote every recipe in its own words, from how the dish is made at home in its region, and checked each one against written rules: the amounts, the oven, the allergens and how to know meat is cooked through. Nobody at Busy has cooked them all yet, and each recipe says so. Tell us how it went, and the recipes get better from what you tell us. Nothing. Busy Kitchen is free, with no account and no AI. Busy Kitchen with Sal, your chef, is $1.49 once on itch.io, and Sal works on your own Claude.

item.title: Busy Rentals 1.0: Be the landlord people hope for.
item.description: Rental management for people who let one home or a few: the dates, the papers, the rent and the tax year, in one place. Homes & Tenancies: Every home you let, who lives there, and every check and certificate with its date and its official source. Rent & Deposits: What came in, what is late, and where each deposit stands: the cap, and the date to protect or return it. Letters to Tenants: A welcome, a visit, a repair, a copy of a certificate and the deposit at the end, in six languages: you choose for each tenant. Costs & the Tax Year: Costs per home with the receipt, and each home's totals for the year, ready for your return or your accountant. England, the Netherlands and Germany: each duty Busy keeps, with how often it comes back, its official page and the date Busy last checked it. In any other country, Busy keeps your homes, rent, deposits, costs and letters, without country dates. Busy Rentals is free, with no account and no subscription. Wren, the AI property manager, comes in the paid edition: Busy Rentals with Wren, $4.99 once on itch.io.

item.title: Busy 2.1: Busy Home 2.1: for a household of any size
item.description: The whole household: Everyone who lives there, people and pets, each with a colour. Say who looks after what, and see just your own things. Shared Costs: Who paid what, and who owes whom: split equally, by income share or your own way, between any number of people. Pets: Vaccinations and check-ups with their next dates, a sitter's booklet as a PDF, and a checklist for travelling with a pet in the EU. Tax time: The date for the UK, the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Italy or Brazil, the papers to gather, and a tag to keep a paper for the return. Drop here: A folder for the scans and photos from your phone: they wait in the tray to be filed. The renewal check: Last year's price beside this year's, and a reminder to compare energy deals before a fixed deal ends. Free, like the rest. Juno, in the paid edition, does the boring part of each for you.

item.title: Busy 2.0: Busy with what matters: every app opens on what needs you today
item.description: Each app now opens on Today: the three things that most need you, and nothing else. The tools sit behind a few clear parts: Brand, Marketing and Operations in Busy Business; My worth, Grow and Say it in Busy Growth; the tray, Dates, Letters and Just in case in Busy Home. Busy Business has your brand on one page and a road for every job, from quote to paid. Busy Growth lays out your notes for a review, the case for a raise and your thirty seconds. Busy Home has a tray for the post and one list of every date at home. The experts have a clearer job: Olaf, your brand consultant; Ivy, your career coach; Juno, your household assistant. Each prepares the work and waits for your yes. New in the paid apps: the expert works on the Claude you already have. You add it to your own Claude app in three steps, with no key. A Claude API key still works. Olaf can now read your invoices, quotes, clients and hours, and prepare a draft or a reminder for you to send. The free tools stay free, with no AI and no account. Everything is in English, Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese.

item.title: Busy 1.0: Olaf, Ivy and Juno are here, and so is the whole of Busy Street
item.description: Each suite now also comes as a paid app with its AI expert inside: Busy Business with Olaf, Busy Growth with Ivy and Busy Home with Juno. You buy one once, on itch.io, and the expert runs on your own Claude key. The free tools stay free, with no AI and no account. Nothing about them has changed. Busy Street: Tuck's Errand has a full edition with 15 levels: the street and nine worlds. Busy Street 3D is out for Mac. The paid apps and both games are in English, Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese. The website has a new page, Free and paid, and a short film of every app.

item.title: Busy 0.9.7: Busy Business starts with your brand
item.description: Busy Business opens on your brand: a brand card first, then your tools in three groups: Grow, Deliver and Run. In Busy Home's Just in Case binder, a contract or a document now opens in its own tool when you click it. Safer apps: a file Busy opens for you is only ever a document or a picture, and two windows can't trip over the same file. The website says plainly what is free and what will be paid: the tools stay free, and a paid version with an AI expert is coming.

item.title: Busy 0.9.6: A new free game: Busy Street: Tuck's Errand
item.description: Tuck only went out to get a stamp back. Six levels, six friends to cut loose from the Red Tape. Play it in your browser, or download it for Mac and Windows with a film at the start and end of every level. The AI experts are coming later, so the site no longer shows prices for them.

item.title: Busy 0.9.5: Puzzles in their room, and every screen in your language
item.description: Play the puzzles in their room: on each game, tap In the room for a real wooden board in the Puzzle Parlour. Every place opens with a short film, and follows the seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Rooms that follow your own work: boxes on the stock shelves, unpaid invoices in the pigeonholes, a leaf on the trellis for every skill, and a drawer label that glows before a document expires. Every screen now speaks your language, Olaf, Ivy and Juno included.

item.title: Busy 0.9.4: Busy speaks your language
item.description: Busy now speaks Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese as well as English. Local rules for each country: the right currency and VAT rates, invoices and reminders in six languages, and letters that name your country's law.

item.title: Busy 0.9.3: Your guide is alive
item.description: Rivet, Pim and Tuck now stand in the room on your home screen, and turn their head to follow you. The rooms follow the clock: in the morning, by day or in the evening, with the light to match.

item.title: Busy 0.9.2: A guide who says what needs you
item.description: Your guide says one line on the home screen about what needs you most, like the last day to cancel a contract or an overdue invoice. The rooms look better, with proper objects: the van, the counter, the glasshouse door, the jar of wins.

item.title: Busy 0.9.1: Every app has its own place
item.description: Each app opens in its own place: the Workshop, the Glasshouse, Tuck's house and the Puzzle Parlour. Every tool has its own room, and the top bar jumps straight to any other tool.

item.title: Busy 0.9.0: Busy as free apps for Mac and Windows
item.description: Busy Business, Busy Growth, Busy Home and Busy Games as free apps for Mac and Windows, one for each part of your life. Your files stay in your own folder as plain files. No account, nothing sent to us.
